en: A black-and-white postcard showing a picturesque view of a historical European village. In the foreground, there is a fenced property with lush trees and shrubbery. Prominently featured is a church with a tall steeple and a weather vane, characteristic of Baroque or late medieval architecture. Next to it is a large building that appears to be the parsonage (Pfarrhaus). The image is framed by large trees, giving it a tranquil, rural atmosphere. The bottom of the postcard features cursive German text.
